title: VEKA | Career | Working at the VEKA Group
content: Careers at the VEKA Group. VEKA is not only the world's leading manufacturer of window profiles, but also an internationally operating family business. We achieve our goals only by the commitment of each individual, by an open and fair cooperation and a maximum of personal responsibility within the entire VEKA Group. ## Working at the VEKA Group. Since 2020, we have been pursuing a clear goal with our global employee surveys: we want to give all VEKA Group employees a voice, regardless of their location or the size of the company. At the same time, we see the feedback as an incentive to continue working on ourselves – in line with our strategy **"we care | we act | we grow."**. At the headquarters in Sendenhorst, there are several central functions for the entire VEKA Group. Within our VEKA profile business there are numerous job offers from different areas: From production and manufacturing, to warehouse logistics and administrative activities. There are also exciting job opportunities worldwide at the numerous subsidiaries.

title: VEKA | Company with family spirit | VEKA Group
content: From Sendenhorst to the whole world - with our 54locations on 4continents including our 23production plants, we are represented worldwide and sell our products internationally. As a family-run company in the second generation, our roots are in Sendenhorst (Münsterland) in Westphalia. Independent subsidiaries on 4continents complete our international presence and provide jobs for around 7,000employees worldwide. With an annual turnover of over 1.5 billion €, of which 80 % is generated abroad on 4continents, the VEKA Group is officially the world market leader in the field of PVC profile systems for windows and doors. With subsidiaries in Europe, Asia, North and South America, we are represented worldwide and provide jobs for around 7,000employees *(data as of December 2024)*. For more than 50 years we have been producing profile systems for windows, doors, roller shutters as well as sliding doors made of PVC. More than 50 years of VEKA. We are looking back on a company history of more than 50 years:.
